transcript.en: Good morning, Kenton Festival box office. How can I help you?
transcript.zh: 早上好，这里是Kenton节假日售票处，请问有什么可以帮到您？

transcript.en: Oh, good morning.
transcript.zh: 早上好，

transcript.en: I'm coming to Kenton for a few days' holiday next month,
transcript.zh: 下个月我会去Kenton度几天假，

transcript.en: and a friend told me there's a festival.
transcript.zh: 有个朋友告诉我那里有个节日。

transcript.en: She gave me this number to find out about it.
transcript.zh: 她给了我这个号码让我自己来问清楚。

transcript.en: That's right, the festival begins on the 16th of May and goes on till the 19th.
transcript.zh: 是的，该节日从5月16号开始，持续到19号。

transcript.en: Oh, that's great.
transcript.zh: 啊，太棒了，

transcript.en: I'll be there from the 15th till the 19th.
transcript.zh: 我会在那从15号待到19号。

transcript.en: So could you tell me the programme. please?
transcript.zh: 请你告诉我一下具体有什么节目。

transcript.en: Well, on the first day, there's the opening ceremony, in the town centre.
transcript.zh: 嗯，第一天在市中心有个开幕式。

transcript.en: People start gathering around 2 o'clock, to get a good place to see from,
transcript.zh: 为了找到一个看节目的好位置，人们两点左右就开始聚集，

transcript.en: and the events will start at 2.45, and finish about 5.30.
transcript.zh: 开幕式2:45开始，5:30左右结束。

transcript.en: OK, thanks.
transcript.zh: 好的，谢谢。

transcript.en: I'll make sure I get there early to get a good spot.
transcript.zh: 我会确保早点到那找个好位置的。

transcript.en: The festival will be officially opened by the mayor.
transcript.zh: 节日将由市长宣布正式开始。

transcript.en: He'll just speak for a few minutes, welcoming everyone to the festival.
transcript.zh: 他会发表几分钟的讲话，欢迎大家来参与这个节日。

transcript.en: All the town councillors will be there, and of course lots of other people.
transcript.zh: 所有的市议员都会出席，当然也还有很多别的人。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好。

transcript.en: Then there'll be a performance by a band.
transcript.zh: 然后会有一个乐队的表演。

transcript.en: Most years we have a children's choir, but this year the local army cadets offered to perform,and they're very good.
transcript.zh: 大多数年份都有儿童合唱，但今年本地军校学员主动要来表演，他们非常棒。

transcript.en: Uhuh.
transcript.zh: 哦，是吗？

transcript.en: After that, a community group from the town will perform a play they've written themselves. just a short one.
transcript.zh: 在那之后，本地的一个社区团体将表演一出他们自己写的短剧。

transcript.en: It's about Helen Tungate. I don't know if you've heard of her?
transcript.zh: 短剧是关于 Helen Tungate的。我不知道您是否听说过她。

transcript.en: I certainly have.
transcript.zh: 我当然听过。

transcript.en: She was a scientist years ago.
transcript.zh: 她是一位很多年前的科学家。

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 是的，

transcript.en: She was born in Kenton exactly 100 years ago,
transcript.zh: 她正好在100年前生于 Kenton，

transcript.en: so we're celebrating her centenary.
transcript.zh: 所以我们会庆祝她的百年诞辰。

transcript.en: I'm a biologist, so I've always been interested in her.
transcript.zh: 我是一个生物学家，所以我一直对她很感兴趣。

transcript.en: I didn't realise she came from Kenton.
transcript.zh: 不过我没意识到她来自 Kenton.

transcript.en: Yes. Well, all that will take place in the afternoon,
transcript.zh: 嗯，刚才说的所有节目都是在下午，

transcript.en: and later. as the sun sets. there'll be a firework display.
transcript.zh: 随后，日落的时候将会有焰火表演。

transcript.en: You should go to the park to watch, as you'll get the best view from there.
transcript.zh: 你应该去公园看的，那儿有最好的视野，

transcript.en: and the display takes place on the opposite side of the river.
transcript.zh: 焰火表演就在河对面。

transcript.en: It's always one of the most popular events in the festival.
transcript.zh: 那一直是节日期间最受欢迎的活动之一。

transcript.en: Sounds great.
transcript.zh: 听起来很赞。

transcript.en: And what's happening on the other days?
transcript.zh: 其余那些天有什么节目呢？

transcript.en: There are several events that go on the whole time.
transcript.zh: 节日期间有好几个活动。

transcript.en: For example, the students of the art college have produced a number of videos.
transcript.zh: 比如说，艺术学院的学生制作了很多视频，

transcript.en: all connected with relationships between children and their grandparents.
transcript.zh: 都是关于祖孙关系的。

transcript.en: That sounds interesting.
transcript.zh: 这听起来挺有趣的。

transcript.en: It makes a change from children and parents, doesn't it!
transcript.zh: 同以前探讨父母与子女关系的不一样。

transcript.en: Exactly.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: Because the art college is in use for classes, throughout the festival,
transcript.zh: 因为艺术学院在节日期间要上课，

transcript.en: the videos are being shown in Handsworth House.
transcript.zh: 所以视频是在 Handsworth House 放映的。

transcript.en: How do you spell the name?
transcript.zh: 那个名字怎么拼？

transcript.en: H-A-N-D-S-W-O-R-T-H.
transcript.zh: H-A-N-D-S-W-O-R-T-H.

transcript.en: Handsworth House.
transcript.zh: Handsworth House。

transcript.en: It's close to the Town Hall.
transcript.zh: 就在市政厅附近。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Now let me see, what else can I tell you about?
transcript.zh: 我想想看，还有别的什么能告诉您的？

transcript.en: Are there any displays of ballet dancing?
transcript.zh: 有芭蕾舞表演吗？

transcript.en: I'm particularly interested in that as I do it as a hobby.
transcript.zh: 我对芭蕾尤其感兴趣，我自己也跳，当是爱好。

transcript.en: There isn't any ballet, I'm afraid,
transcript.zh: 恐怕没有芭蕾表演，

transcript.en: but there'll be a demonstration of traditional dances from all round the country.
transcript.zh: 但是有全国各地的传统舞蹈的汇演。

transcript.en: Oh, that'd be nice.
transcript.zh: 啊，太棒了，

transcript.en: Where's that being held?
transcript.zh: 那在哪举行呢？

transcript.en: It's in the market in the town centre-the outdoor one, not the covered market.
transcript.zh: 在市中心的市场里，室外的那个，不是室内的。

transcript.en: And it's on at 2 and 5 every afternoon of the festival, apart from the first day.
transcript.zh: 除了第一天，节日期间的每天下午两点和五点开始。

transcript.en: Lovely. I'm interested in all kinds of dancing, so I'm sure I'll enjoy that!
transcript.zh: 太棒了！我对所有种类的舞蹈都感兴趣，我确信我会很享受那些表演的。

transcript.en: Mmm. I'm sure you will.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我确信你会的。

transcript.en: And I'd really like to go to some concerts, if there are any.
transcript.zh: 如果有音乐会的话，我也很想去看看。

transcript.en: Yes, there are several.
transcript.zh: 嗯，有的，有好几个。

transcript.en: Three performed by professionals, and one by local children.
transcript.zh: 有三个是职业乐手的表演，还有一个是本地儿童的表演。

transcript.en: And where is it being held?
transcript.zh: 那在哪举行的呢？

transcript.en: It's in the library, which is in Park Street.
transcript.zh: 在公园街的图书馆举行。

transcript.en: On the 18th, at 6.30 in the evening.
I presume I'll need tickets for that.
transcript.zh: 我想我应该要买票。

transcript.en: Yes, you can book online.
transcript.zh: 是的，您可以在网上订，

transcript.en: or you can buy them when you arrive in Kenton,
transcript.zh: 或者在您到Kenton的时候

transcript.en: either at the festival box office.
transcript.zh: 在节假日售票处

transcript.en: or from any shops displaying our logo in the windows.
transcript.zh: 或是任何窗口带有我们商标的商店买都行。

transcript.en: Well, I think that'll keep me busy for the whole of my stay in Kenton.
transcript.zh: 好的。我想我在Kenton的那些天都会很忙了。

transcript.en: Thank you so much for all your help.
transcript.zh: 非常感谢你的帮助。

transcript.en: You're welcome.
transcript.zh: 不客气

transcript.en: I hope you enjoy your stay.
transcript.zh: 希望您能享受在Kenton的时光。

transcript.en: Thank you. Goodbye.
transcript.zh: 谢谢，再见。
